title: [CQ-I01] Capability negotiated wire contracts
description:

Deliverable: Capability negotiated wire contracts. This is task I01 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

implementationPlan.description: Add a small pure v1 wire-contract module (no framework or new dependency). Request: {type:'CLIENT_HELLO',payload:{protocolVersion:1,capabilities:{[key:string]:boolean}}}; reply: {type:'SERVER_CAPABILITIES',payload:{protocolVersion:1,capabilities:<server map>,negotiatedCapabilities:<intersection>}}. Both output maps contain exactly these known keys: executionProfiles, planRevisions, approvalRevisions, executionContracts, deliveryReceipts, requiredChecks = true on server; runnerStatus, modelReceipts, verifiedLocal = false. Negotiated values are server true AND client literal true; absent known keys mean false. Require a non-null non-array payload and capabilities object; known present capability values must be booleans, protocolVersion must be a safe integer equal to 1. Explicit error handling: invalid shape/type -> existing invalidInput/INVALID_INPUT; other integer version -> MoeError NOT_ALLOWED with codeName UNSUPPORTED_CLIENT_PROTOCOL. Ignore unknown optional keys and inspect only the fixed known-key list so untrusted keys are neither retained nor spread. Existing 2 MiB WS frame limit bounds input. Add concise type/comments explaining that support is not evidence/readiness and attemptPhase is not managed runnerStatus. Exercise these pure decoding branches in the test file from step 1.
implementationPlan.note: Added 43-line pure fixed-key decoder and explicit typed agreement. Exact nine server booleans, intersection, safe-integer version handling, malformed-known validation, ignored unknowns, no input spreading/retention. Added direct pure decoder assertions over step-1 malformed matrix plus version/immutability. Native snapshot focused decoder test passes (1), supplemental npx tsc --noEmit exits 0; wire integration remains RED until step 3. No activation or peer edits.

implementationPlan.description: Integrate CLIENT_HELLO in PluginMessage/handlePluginMessage and return SERVER_CAPABILITIES only to the requesting socket using safeSend. Store negotiation locally in a WeakMap (or explicit lifecycle-cleaned map), never in Task/project/settings. An attempted hello without a successful result marks the socket non-legacy/read-only until a valid hello succeeds. Once successful, canonical identical repeats re-ack; different repeats fail NOT_ALLOWED/CLIENT_CAPABILITIES_LOCKED without changing the established result. Malformed repeats must not erase prior valid state. Serialize negotiation/admission consistently with withMutex. Add one shared connection-admission check called INSIDE the existing mutex immediately before BOTH state.approveTask calls: no hello -> existing behavior; attempted but unsuccessful hello or negotiated planRevisions !== true -> NOT_ALLOWED/UNSUPPORTED_CLIENT_CAPABILITY; supported negotiation with omitted expectedPlanRevision -> INVALID_INPUT. Otherwise pass the original token unchanged to state.approveTask for its existing validation, CAS, durable stamp and unconditional verified-local readiness refusal; never substitute a cached/current revision. Do not intercept non-approval UPDATE_TASK edits, alter automatic/MCP admission, change snapshots/projections, or widen the error-context allowlist. Client claims must never toggle server support/readiness. Complete tests from step 1, including independent simultaneous sockets and an approval queued behind a material revision edit; queued old tokens must still fail the store CAS with no write.
implementationPlan.note: Integrated optional hello through state mutex, WeakMap absent/null/agreement states, canonical intersection locking, shared admission immediately before both approveTask calls. No snapshot/projection/store/client changes. Added queued material edit races for both routes, simultaneous approvals, and pipelined malformed-hello-before-approval ordering. Full WebSocketServer.test.ts: 101 passed (73 new), native source snapshot. Production and owned test-file strict typechecks both exit 0. Explicit boolean null check in existing error context guard resolves unknown-payload TS2698 without widening context keys. Existing 488 unrelated dirty paths preserved; no Git writes.
